summary.suggested: The Missouri Republican reported that the two prize fighters of St. Louis, Tom Kelly and Tom Allen, would soon give a steamboat excursion.

metadata.notes: Masthead: The Republican: St. Louis, Wednesday Morning, June 11, 1884, page 6. It was the Missouri Republican until 1888.

notes: A single-sentence notice; no biography-level fact.
